overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Administrative Policy Committee was scheduled to meet on November 17, 2026, to address budget matters including the 2027 budget presentation, multiple budget amendments, tax increment district closure updates, and health insurance options for 2027. The meeting was set to cover significant financial planning and administrative policy decisions for the village.

agenda.item: Approval of October 13, 2026 Administrative Policy Committee Meeting Minutes
Approval of October 19, 2026 Proposed Budget Workshop #1 Meeting Minutes
Approval of October 20, 2026 Proposed Budget Workshop #2 Meeting Minutes
Update on Estimated Closure Dates for All Four Tax Increment Districts
2026 Budget Amendment #5 - Park Grant Matching Funds

discussions.item: Update on Estimated Closure Dates for All Four Tax Increment Districts
discussions.body: The committee was set to receive an update regarding the estimated closure dates for all four tax increment districts in the village. This report was expected to provide information on the timeline for TID closure and any associated implications for municipal finances.

The committee was scheduled to review the proposed 2027 budget for the Village of Kronenwetter. This presentation was expected to outline revenue projections, expenditure plans, and other fiscal considerations for the upcoming year.
The committee was set to discuss December 2026 assessed tax rates. This item was expected to inform members of current tax assessment information relevant to village planning and budgeting.

discussions.item: 2026 Budget Amendment #5 - Park Grant Matching Funds
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to consider a budget amendment to address park grant matching funds. This action was expected to allocate or adjust village funding to support a park-related grant opportunity.

The committee was set to discuss and potentially act on a budget amendment affecting the General Fund and Tax Increment District 3. This amendment was expected to address funding adjustments between these accounts.

The committee was scheduled to consider health insurance options through Teamcare for the 2027-2029 period. This discussion was expected to evaluate coverage and cost implications for village employees.
The committee was set to review health insurance options through United Health Care for 2027. This item was expected to present an alternative health insurance provider option for consideration.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, with a 15-minute total limit and three-minute individual time limit per person.
